en.t: Why could he still not see the sea?

units.source_text: 也许是地面蜿蜒曲折，瞧不远的关系吧，完全雷同的风景，无边无际地延续着。

en.t: Perhaps because the ground wound and twisted so much that he could not see far, the utterly identical scenery went on endlessly.

units.source_text: 忽然，豁然一亮，他眼前出现了一个小小的村落。

en.t: Suddenly, the view opened brightly, and a small village appeared before his eyes.

units.source_text: 以高高的瞭望楼为中心，聚集了许多简陋房屋，

en.t: With a tall lookout tower at the center, many shabby houses were clustered together,

units.source_text: 屋顶上用小石块压着木板，这是个常见的贫困破败的小村落。

en.t: their roofs held down with wooden boards weighted by small stones; it was the sort of poor, dilapidated little village one often sees.

units.source_text: 当然，其中也有几幢房子的屋顶，铺着黑黑的瓦片，有几幢房子的屋顶，还包上了铁红色的洋铁皮。

en.t: Of course, among them were a few houses with roofs laid in black tiles, and a few whose roofs were covered with iron-red galvanized sheets.

units.source_text: 包洋铁皮屋顶的房子，是村子里唯一一幢四四方方的建筑物，看上去像是“渔业联合组织”的活动中心。

en.t: The house with the sheet-metal roof was the only square building in the village and looked like the activity center of the “Fisheries Cooperative Association.”
